items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE
items.summary: A critical remote code execution (RCE) flaw allowing unauthenticated attackers to run arbitrary PHP on the server, requiring a manual patch.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution, which was actively exploited.

items.title: Incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows unauthorized access to customer accounts without existing privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation, with one issue being an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVSS 9.1).

items.title: Adobe Security Bulletin APSB25-71
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, 6 critical
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for dozens of extensions, with six critical flaws including remote code execution and account takeover. CVE-2026-53787 is an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability in Amasty Order Attributes.
